_README: Deployment properties the packing solver needs and module-family.json does not carry. Access directions are DERIVED from this project's own VISUAL-DESIGN-BRIEF.md required-visible-content list - they are design intent, not vendor claims. Masses are NOT yet sourced and every one is marked UNVERIFIED; the solver refuses to report a payload verdict while that is true.

_access_values.front: opens toward the tailgate; needs clear depth in front of it at its own height band
_access_values.top: opens upward; needs nothing stacked above and clear height to the bay ceiling

modules.name: Cook Station
modules.why: pull-out stove tray needs its full travel; upper prep surface deploys upward

modules.name: Dry Pantry
modules.why: three pull-out drawers on full-extension guides

modules.name: Fridge/Freezer
modules.why: top-opening lid. Nothing may be stacked above this module, ever.

modules.name: Sink/Wash
modules.why: recessed basin and raised faucet work from above; lower service door from the front

modules.name: Fresh Water
modules.why: spigot and service bay from the front; fill cap from above

modules.name: Recovery/Utility
modules.why: lower sealed tool drawer plus front MOLLE panel

modules.name: Power Hub
modules.why: front display and port array; cable drawer; ventilation must not be blocked

modules.name: Hot Water/Shower
modules.why: heater face, controls and quick-connects are all front-facing

modules.name: Field Office/Camera
modules.why: deployable worktop and open laptop need both depth and headroom

modules.name: Camp Furniture
modules.why: front cargo net and compression straps; contents lift out forward
